svg.title: Nongwaste System Overview
svg.desc: LINE plastic detection and location reports connect to a FastAPI backend, Ultralytics YOLO, Google Cloud Storage and Firebase Realtime Database. A public Google Maps web page reads reported locations and submits cleanup evidence to the backend.

g.text: System overview · plastic analysis, waste locations and cleanup evidence
